Detailed Description

Parameters to create a rod actor.

A rod actor is a 1D deformable body whose geometry is a polyline.

See also
Scene::CreateRodActor

◆ shape

ShapeHandle superdex::RodActorParams::shape

Shape handle defining the rod geometry.

Must be a polyline shape.

Note
Each element's frame axis is interpreted as one cross-sectional principal axis (the other is the cross product of the segment direction and that axis); the flexural stiffness components are defined with respect to these axes.
A rod actor uses a visual mesh only when the shape has embedding data. For shapes created from ModelData, the embedding is built from the skinning data in ModelData::visualMesh. Without visual-mesh skinning, Context::GetShapeVisualMesh still returns the shape's visual mesh, but the rod actor ignores it: Actor::GetVisualMesh returns an empty view, and QueryType::VisualNodePositions and QueryType::VisualNodeNormals are unsupported.
Setting useContactSkin to true requires ModelData::contactSkinMesh.

◆ useContactSkin

bool superdex::RodActorParams::useContactSkin = false

Use the rod shape's contact skin for contact instead of its centerline.

Actor creation fails if the shape does not have a contact skin.

Note
The contact skin is exposed through Actor::GetContactSkinMesh and QueryType::ContactSkinNodePositions / QueryType::ContactSkinNodeNormals independently of this flag.
